item.title: Açaí, chipotle and gnocchi – and other words you are probably mispronouncing
item.summary: The English language can seem designed to trip us up, whether we’re greeting a colonel or travelling to Worcestershire. Here are some of the biggest stumbling blocks Name: Açaí. Age: First imported to western countries from South America as freeze-dried pulp in the 1990s. Continue reading...
